bibliography.usage: Source of fixed facts, not prose to reproduce

evaluation_facts.fact: UTKFace target images use 13 corruption types at severity 5. Predict age; R2 is higher-better and may be negative.
Source is the unadapted comparator. Oracle has target-label access and is not a same-information competitor.
The supplied cells are rounded author-reported aggregate values, not independent experimental repetitions.

method_facts.fact: A source-trained feature extractor feeds a fixed linear regression head w.T z + b.
Source feature covariance supplies leading eigenvectors V and positive eigenvalues lambda; project centered features as V(z-mu_source).
Per-axis target batch means and variances are aligned to source moments (0, lambda) with a weighted symmetric Gaussian KL objective; alpha_d = 1 + abs(w.T v_d).
Source data are unavailable during target adaptation; source statistics were obtained beforehand. Target labels are not adaptation inputs.
Adaptation updates only the feature extractor's normalization affine scale and shift parameters (gamma, beta); other model parameters, including the regression head, remain fixed.

scope: Regression test-time adaptation; the numeric evidence supplied here concerns corrupted UTKFace age prediction only.
unknown_or_excluded: Per-run observations and sampling uncertainty are not supplied.
